title: Wildlife
description: An animal and the surface it is standing on are the subject. That surface may be a branch, a rock, a hand, or a post. Lift the animal a little, brighten the eye, and when dark water holds a reflection, sharpen that mirror and lift it with them. The foliage behind them falls soft. The perch stays sharp with the animal.
reason: The animal and the perch it stands on stay sharp. The animal is lifted, the eye is brightened, a reflection in the water is sharpened and lifted with them, and the background falls soft.

features.animal: The animal stays sharp, lifted a little, with the eye clarified.
features.perch: The branch, rock, hand, or post it is standing on stays sharp with it.
features.background: Foliage and the rest of the place fall soft.

subject.skip: Skip the animal when no compact creature stands apart from the scene.

eyes.skip: Skip the eye when no eye, or no small dark spot standing in for one, is inside the animal.

skin.skip: Skip skin. Skin smoothing does not belong on this picture.

sky.skip: Skip the sky. The sky is not a separate grade here.

reflection.skip: Skip the reflection when no darker mirror of the animal sits in the water below it.

background.skip: Skip the background when the animal could not be isolated.

foreground.skip: Skip the foreground. The frame is handled by the global grade.
